description: Buy a token paying with the chain's native token (ETH, BNB, SOL...). Auto-bridge from other chains is on by default, as on gdex.pro.

accountRef.description: Connected account from gdex_connect. Supplies session key, wallet address, API key and session data so no secret is passed in chat

apiKey.description: GDEX API key for AES encryption

autoBridge.description: Automatic funding (default true, as on gdex.pro): bridge USDC and top up native gas from the user's other chains, within maxSourceSpendRaw

chainId.description: Chain ID: 1, 10, 56, 146, 8453, 42161 or 622112261 (Solana). No USDC on Robinhood 4663 or Fraxtal 252

maxSourceSpendRaw.description: Signed cap on total source spend for auto-funding (default ceil(amount x 1.2)), raw integer units

minTokenOutRaw.description: Minimum token out, raw integer units

nativeAmountRaw.description: Native amount to spend (18 decimals EVM, 9 Solana), raw integer units

name: usdc_buy_with_native
